title: ForgeCycle roadmap manifest (roadmap.json)
description: The machine-readable roadmap that roadmap decompose writes and roadmap runs read. Array order is execution order; each task depends only on earlier tasks. Paths are relative to the manifest's directory.

source_plan.description: Snapshot of the decomposed plan, relative to the manifest's directory

decisions.description: The decisions document, relative to the manifest's directory; it must resolve inside the repository. A roadmap run refuses to start while one of its decisions is open, and gives every task run the answers (ADR 0028)

file.description: The task file, relative to the manifest's directory; it must resolve inside the repository
